_comment: Lean 4-camera demo tuned for a sharp live run: 3 cameras that reliably CONFIRM a threat (theft) + 1 that reliably gets SUPPRESSED (normal till/desk work TrueSight rejects), so the noise-suppression counter, alerts, timeline, map, live-wall flash, and real-video clips all have something to show. Fewer cameras than the 6-cam wall = higher per-camera fps (clips fill), lower gate latency. Every alert is still TrueSight-verified.
